title: The Airship That Fell From the Sky
subtitle: The Hindenburg disaster, Lakehurst, New Jersey, May 6, 1937
angle: The Hindenburg was coming in for a landing when it caught fire and fell from the sky — 36 people died in thirty-four seconds, and the cause remains officially undetermined.
audience: US adults 25-55 following history, aviation failures, and true-story accounts

ai_disclosure.reason: Every image is an authentic historical document, 1937. No generative imagery was used at any stage. The cover image is the Sam Shere photograph from Wikimedia Commons, published 1937.

quotations.reason: No quotation could be verified word-for-word with a stable citation.

rights.international_caveat: The Sam Shere photograph is public domain in the United States (published 1937; copyright not renewed). The 1937 NARA and LoC source images are also in the public domain. All imagery is free for US-based audience and US platforms.
